reason: I lost a $9,000 kitchen job last month because a quote sat unanswered, so one saved job pays for the setup and a good part of the year. The free demo costs me nothing and he walks away if my missed calls are too few, so I would sit down with him and sign on the Essential plan if the count is there.
objection: $1,999.99 up front is a lot for something I can't touch yet, and the refund only needs 10 caller requests I didn't pick up, not 10 real jobs. I could still pay for a pile of tire-kickers and wrong numbers and not get that money back.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo shows I only miss a few calls a month, I'm out. A low missed-call count means it won't pay for itself.
